name: FeAR-Relief
summary:
FeAR-Relief lets you practise facing spiders at your own pace, in your own living room. The app detects the floor, walls and furniture of your room and lets virtual spiders walk where you place them: on the floor, up the wall, across the ceiling. You set the pace.

Four difficulty levels. From a single small, slow spider to several larger, faster ones that also climb walls and ceiling. Each level is designed to challenge without overwhelming.

You stay in control. Choose the level and the number of spiders
